description: The orders of the app's physical products (a product with `shipping`). Each paid physical product is an order with the buyer's address (name, phone, address), the zone and postage paid, and a status: paid → shipped (with carrier and tracking number, and its link) → delivered, or returned. "list" { status?, skip?, limit? }: newest first, each with its withdrawal ({ until, open, daysLeft }: the EU's 14 days from the delivery), refunded when its payment was refunded, test for pre's test purchases; "get" { orderId }. Changes nothing; neblla_orders moves an order on.
name: neblla_orders_read
title: Orders (read)
